meta.title: Postcard Pairs
meta.instructions: Match the postcards from around your new city: the park, the bridge, the tram, the market, the ferry, the waterfront, the hill and the kite field. Tap two to flip them. Nine slips and the mail is lost.

shown.body: let i = c.y * 4 + c.x in i < len(cards) and hint_active and not cards[i].revealed and not cards[i].matched

cell_fill.body: if shown(c) then face_color(cards[c.y * 4 + c.x].symbol) else ''

cell_label.body: if shown(c) then face_letter(cards[c.y * 4 + c.x].symbol) else ''

art.style: A writing desk: kraft paper with airmail stripes, cream postcard backs with stamps, little painted city views.
